## How this site works

Every page is a `.qmd` file — markdown with a small config block at the top. Quarto turns them into this website when I run `quarto preview`.

That means I focus on **writing**, not wrestling with HTML tags.

## A little Python

This code runs while Quarto builds the page:

```{python}
favorite_numbers = [3, 8, 16, 42]
print(sum(favorite_numbers))
```
